event.label: Still listed in 1940, the last directory transcribed so far

body.p: Little Pelham Street is a narrow street running between Leicester Street and Bouverie Street, just north of Pelham Street.
It is first listed in the directories in 1869. It is missing from the 1875 to 1877 directories, and then listed in every directory up to 1940, the last one transcribed so far.

div.head: Along the street
div.p: From 1905 the directories list the houses on its north side, starting from the Bouverie Street end and finishing at Leicester Street.

div.head: Businesses and landmarks

list.item: National Motor Reconditioning Pty Ltd (1930) and the Rhodes Motor Co. (1935).
A. C. Hatrick Pty Ltd, merchants, at Nos 16 to 24 (1940).

div.p: In 1930 one house, No. 28, is listed only as "Italians".

div.head: Records
div.p: Every directory and electoral-roll listing for Little Pelham Street can be browsed in search. Each directory year links to its own page from Sands & McDougall Directories.
